items.html: And her wings become for them like partitions, like the clouds of glory that were spread over Israel in the desert, guarding them from arrows and catapult stones and the like. And behold, she hovers and surrounds over them, and clothes them from all their sides, and even from below them, beneath their feet. And as was explained in the Gate of Prayer, in the blessing "Who clothes the naked," and in the blessing "Who has provided me with all my needs"; and there was explained the matter of the supernal garments and shoes, what they are. So that there is beneath the feet of ZON one screen, separating like the shoe of the feet. And there is no need to elaborate further here.
